title: Tangy Ginger Hoisin Sauce
summary: Hoisin sauce sharpened with rice vinegar, grated ginger and spring onion.

steps.title: Stir
steps.text: Stir the hoisin, vinegar and ginger together until smooth and glossy.

steps.title: Add
steps.text: Fold in most of the sliced spring onion.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon into a small bowl and top with the rest of the spring onion.

steps.title: Wrap
steps.text: Serve with thin pancakes, cucumber batons, spring onion strips and roast chicken for wrapping.

tips: Grate the ginger on a fine grater so it melts into the sauce.
Add 1 tsp water if the hoisin is very thick.
Also good brushed on chicken in the last minutes of roasting.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 5 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
